questions.stem: With regard to arterial occlusive disease, pick the incorrect statement:
questions.stemHtml: With regard to arterial occlusive disease, pick the incorrect statement:

options.label: A
options.text: The most common cause of peripheral arterial disease is atherosclerosis.

options.label: B
options.text: The most common symptom of chronic lower limb arterial stenosis is intermittent claudication.

options.label: C
options.text: Chronic stenosis has a more severe presentation, as compared to acute limb ischemia.

options.label: D
options.text: Intermittent claudication mainly occurs due to anaerobic muscle metabolism.
